title: 第3章 莫森帝国第4章 犯人们
slug: 兼职管理女子监狱的异端审判官
content_zh:
“总之，希望不要再有奇怪的事件了”，狄曼列放下钢笔：“至少赫尔莎回来之前不要有”
“你别只压榨人家一个人”，摩菲拍了拍自己的大腿：“她才二十几岁，已经有百岁老人的精神状态了，都快没人要了”
“大不了我娶了她”，狄曼列躺在椅子上，顺手翻看着新一批犯人的记录：“这么敬业还不要加薪的下属，肯定要好好抓住啊”
“我看出来了，你不是渣男”，摩菲鄙夷的开口：“用你们异世灵魂的话，你应该被挂在路灯上吊死”
狄曼列不以为然：“可惜，莫森帝国没有这段历史，以后大概率也不会有”
说着，狄曼列看向了某个方向，眼中似乎隐约浮现了一座辉煌的皇宫，喃喃自语：“不过这些年，那位皇帝，似乎也在弄些小动作啊.......”
莫森帝国，是这个世界中众多大陆上唯二的人类国家之一，整体上保持着狄曼列上一个世界中西方中世纪国家的社会体系。狄曼列目前所在的水晶城就是莫森帝国的一座偏远城市，被一位伯爵统治着
不过尽管有着贵族与皇帝，莫森帝国的阶级矛盾却并没有那么严重，贵族虽然依旧享受很大的特权与资产，但并不能随意欺压他人，更不被允许践踏生命
在莫森帝国，有着非常齐全的律法，其中覆盖了方方面面，包括但不仅限于经济、教育、社会治安等方面
这么完整的律法其实得益于漫长历史中偶尔出现的穿越者，他们来自不同的世界，或者同一世界里不同的地点与时间，来自不同体系与认知的碰撞，造就了莫森帝国如今律法的完整
不过莫森帝国整体的生产力与技术水平仍然停留在比较落后的阶段，群众的意识也并没有觉醒很多，导致律法只能停留在完整的程度，而不是完善
但仅仅是这份律法，就已经能保证所有的平民得到到吃饱肚子粮食，以及最基本的尊严与权利
在这个国家，别说一般贵族，哪怕是公主和王子触犯了律法，随意践踏生命与他人的尊严人权，都将被处以极刑
这份律法是由莫森帝国的开国皇帝————莫尔森一世签署的，没有谁可以违逆它，无论精灵还是兽人，都绝不允许
至于那些试图逃脱或反抗律法的人出现时，阴影中的利刃也会随之出现——————【异端审判局】
一个在莫森帝国几乎无人不知的，负责处理所有违背律法人员的庞大组织
只要是违背律法，破坏社会秩序的存在，他们就会无视一切将其湮灭抹杀，无论身份、原因、种族、危险性.......
在大众的认知中，异端审判局他们不在乎清除异端以外的事情，只要被定为异端，就算是异端手中有着成千上万的人质，异端审判官们也绝不会有丝毫的犹豫和妥协，一切都以清除异端为优先，因此导致无辜者死亡的情况并不少
在这种行为下，异端审判官变的人厌狗嫌，哪怕是不同种族，见到异端审判官也是嫌恶与恐惧
何况异端审判官不会因为任何人而改变行为，哪怕被定为异端的是自己的亲人，他们也会毫不犹豫的将其审判

只不过，虽然异端审判局人见人厌，但它所拥有的力量却强大到令人恐惧
根据异端审判局的分级，异端审判官以个体实力划分等级
初级审判官，中级审判官，高等审判官
不提高级审判官，哪怕只是中级审判官，起步都至少能徒手撕裂非纯血的普通巨龙
至于高级审判官，那更是足以弑杀恶魔与地狱泰坦的家伙，一座中型城市的首席骑士和大魔法师估计也只够他们热身
而这样的存在，不说其他地方，光是莫森帝国的每座城市，就有不止一个
高级审判官其实已经足以担任异端审判局分局局长了，莫森帝国每座城市都至少会有一个审判局分局
但令大部分群众疑惑的是，唯有一座名为水晶城的城市例外，这座城市不仅没有异端审判局分局，就连像样的异端审判官也没有
在他们印象中，唯一能和审判局沾上关系的，只有鸢尾花监狱的典狱长狄曼列曾经是一名强大的审判官
只不过根据传言，狄曼列在某次任务受了重伤，之后就被审判局革职派遣到鸢尾花监狱担任典狱长了
但这也只是传言，毕竟对于水晶城的群众来说，他们认识的狄曼列也只是一个比较厉害的典狱长，而他也没有和任何人提过自己和异端审判局是否有关系，一直到现在——————
.......
“赫尔莎什么时候回来啊.......”
坐在狄曼列有些痛苦放下今天最后一份要处理的文件
“她才刚休假两天”
幽灵一样的摩菲拍了拍狄曼列的脑袋，但手臂却是突然变的透明，面色变的有些严肃：“不聊了，有个麻烦的家伙”
狄曼列看着摩菲逐渐消失的身影，也是点了点头：“你当心”
摩菲挥了挥手，身形也彻底消散，只留下最后一点声音：“当然，你们可要快点.......”
看着空荡的办公室，狄曼列站起身，拿出怀表看了看：“嗯，该去巡视牢房了”
正当他准备迈开步伐时，狄曼列像是想到了什么，缓缓低下了头，目光似乎穿透地底，看向了某个存在

良久，他收回目光，披上一件黑色大衣后随手拿过了墙角那根隐藏着锋利寒芒的手杖
：。：
content_en:
"In short, I hope there won't be any more strange incidents." Diamanlie put down his pen: "At least not until Helsa comes back."
"Don't exploit just one person." Murphy patted his thigh: "She is only in her twenties, but she already has the mental state of a centenarian. Almost no one wants her anymore."
"The worst case scenario is that I'll marry her." Dimanlie lay on the chair and flipped through the records of the new batch of prisoners: "Subordinates who are so dedicated and don't want a salary increase must be caught."
"I can tell, you are not a scumbag," Murphy said disdainfully: "In the words of your otherworldly souls, you should be hung from a street lamp."
Dimanlie disagreed: "It's a pity that the Moson Empire does not have this history, and there is a high probability that it will not have it in the future."
As he spoke, Dimanlie looked in a certain direction, and a brilliant palace seemed to vaguely appear in his eyes, and murmured to himself: "But in recent years, the emperor seems to have been making some small moves..."
The Mawson Empire is one of the only human countries on many continents in this world. As a whole, it maintains the social system of the Western medieval countries in the previous world of Diman. The Crystal City where Dimanlie is currently located is a remote city in the Mawson Empire, ruled by a count.
However, despite the presence of nobles and emperors, the class conflict in the Mohsen Empire is not that serious. Although the nobles still enjoy great privileges and assets, they are not allowed to bully others at will, nor are they allowed to trample on their lives.
In the Moson Empire, there are very complete laws, which cover all aspects, including but not limited to economy, education, social security, etc.
Such a complete law is actually due to the occasional time-travelers in the long history. They come from different worlds, or different places and times in the same world, and come from the collision of different systems and cognitions, creating the completeness of the laws of the Mohsen Empire today.
However, the overall productivity and technical level of the Mohsen Empire are still at a relatively backward stage, and the consciousness of the masses has not awakened much, resulting in the law being only complete rather than perfect.
But this law alone can ensure that all civilians have enough food, as well as the most basic dignity and rights.
In this country, not to mention ordinary nobles, even princesses and princes who violate the law and trample on life and the dignity and human rights of others will be sentenced to death.
This law was signed by Molson I, the founding emperor of the Molson Empire. No one can violate it, neither elves nor orcs.
As for those who try to escape or defy the law, the sharp blade in the shadow will also appear————[Inquisition Bureau]
A huge organization that almost everyone in the Mohsen Empire is responsible for dealing with all those who violate the law.
As long as it violates the law and disrupts the social order, they will ignore everything and annihilate it, regardless of identity, reason, race, danger...
In the public perception, the Heretic Inquisition does not care about anything other than clearing out heretics. As long as they are designated as heretics, even if the heretics have thousands of hostages in their hands, the Heretic Inquisitors will never hesitate or compromise. Everything prioritizes the elimination of heretics, so there are many cases where innocent people die.
Under this kind of behavior, the Heretic Inquisitor becomes a disgusting person. Even if they are of different races, they will still feel disgust and fear when they see the Heretic Inquisitor.
What's more, heretic judges will not change their behavior because of anyone. Even if the person convicted of heresy is their own relative, they will not hesitate to judge him.
However, although the Inquisition is hated by everyone, the power it possesses is so powerful that it is terrifying.
According to the classification of the Heretic Inquisition Bureau, the Heretic Inquisitors are divided into levels based on their individual strength.
Junior Inquisitor, Intermediate Inquisitor, Senior Inquisitor
No higher inquisitor, even if he is only an intermediate judge, he can at least tear apart ordinary non-pure-blooded dragons with his bare hands at the beginning.
As for the senior inquisitor, he is a guy who can kill demons and hell titans. The chief knight and great magician of a medium-sized city are probably only enough to warm them up.
And there is more than one such existence in every city in the Mawson Empire, not to mention other places.
The senior inquisitor is actually enough to serve as the branch director of the Heretic Bureau. Every city in the Mohsen Empire has at least one branch of the Inquisition Bureau.
But what puzzles most people is that the only exception is a city called Crystal City. Not only does this city not have a branch of the Heresy Bureau, it doesn't even have a decent heresy judge.
In their minds, the only person who could have anything to do with the Inquisition Bureau was the warden of Iris Prison, Diamenlie, who was once a powerful inquisitor.
However, according to rumors, Dimanlie was seriously injured during a certain mission, and was later dismissed by the Trial Bureau and sent to Iris Prison as the warden.
But this is just a rumor. After all, for the people in Crystal City, the Diamanlie they know is only a relatively powerful warden, and he has never mentioned to anyone whether he has anything to do with the Heresy Tribunal. Until now——
.......
"When will Helsa come back..."
It was a bit painful to sit in the Diman column and put down the last document to be processed today.
"She just took two days off."
The ghost-like Murphy patted Di Manlie on the head, but his arm suddenly became transparent and his face became a little serious: "No more chatting, there is a troublesome guy."
Dimanlie looked at Murphy's disappearing figure and nodded: "Be careful."
Murphy waved his hand, and his figure completely disappeared, leaving only his last voice: "Of course, you have to hurry up..."
Looking at the empty office, Dimanlie stood up, took out his pocket watch and looked at it: "Well, it's time to inspect the cells."
Just as he was about to take a step forward, Diamanlie seemed to have thought of something and slowly lowered his head. His eyes seemed to penetrate the ground and look at a certain existence.
After a long time, he withdrew his gaze, put on a black coat and casually took the cane in the corner with a sharp and cold light hidden in it.
